plan.title: Reverse auction auto title for same-family products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to a reverse buy auction while leaving the title untouched.
Confirm that auction templates are offered before selecting one.
Apply the auction pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add two line items; the catalog cannot ensure they are distinct members of the specified family.
Set the first product's location to the specified plant.
Set the second product's location to the specified plant.

steps.note: Assert the automatically generated reverse-auction title after both locations are selected.
Remove one line to exercise title recalculation while the title remains automatic.
